operating_margin_pct = income / sales * 100; sales_index = sales / 2019 sales * 100
2019 growth is NULL; 2020-2024 growth uses prior-year sales. Negative income is valid.

2019: Pre-pandemic baseline | 2020-2021: Pandemic disruption | 2022-2024: Subsequent adjustment
Mark stages on charts; compare sales index to 100 and operating margin to 2019 in percentage points.
Descriptive patterns only. One pre-pandemic year cannot establish trends or identify a causal effect.
DataFrames live in memory. HTML / CSV / JSON / SQLite / PNG / Markdown files persist on disk.
All destinations are project-relative. S1-S4 source links and full schemas are in diagram_guide.md.
Stage boundaries are study conventions; the 2022-2024 adjustment period may still include pandemic effects.
